identification: 4 modern illustrated children's hardbacks: The Classic Tales of Beatrix Potter (Warne omnibus); Through the Looking-Glass and What Alice Found There (Lewis Carroll, modern illustrated edition, Humpty Dumpty cover); The Annotated Alice (Carroll, Tenniel illus., Martin Gardner intro and notes, Bramhall House-style reprint in jacket); Winnie-the-Pooh: The Complete Collection of Stories and Poems (Milne/Shepard, map cover). All late reprints, none early.
